audience.text: Developers building .NET applications that require programmatic 3D scene creation, manipulation, and format conversion without native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Construct and traverse 3D scene graphs using Scene and Node classes with primitive and profile geometry.
capabilities.title: Build 3D scene graphs

capabilities.text: Assign shading materials such as LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, and PbrMaterial, and convert between material types.
capabilities.title: Assign and convert materials

capabilities.text: Read and write FBX, glTF, Wavefront OBJ, STL, COLLADA, U3D, 3MF, RVM, AMF, and HTML5/Aspose 3D Web viewer exports.
capabilities.title: Convert between 3D formats

capabilities.text: Control per-format load/save behavior using dedicated options types such as ObjLoadOptions and ColladaSaveOptions.
capabilities.title: Configure format-specific options

capabilities.text: Read and write per-vertex mesh data including normals, UVs, vertex color, tangent/binormal, and user data.
capabilities.title: Handle mesh vertex data

capabilities.text: Animate scenes using AnimationClip, AnimationChannel, KeyFrame, Bone, Skeleton, and SkinDeformer constructs.
capabilities.title: Support animation and skinning

limitations.text: Rendering is not implemented — Scene.Render and related rendering pipeline components throw NotImplementedException.
PLY import and export work via Scene.Open/Save but the public FileFormat.PLY field and its Encode/Decode methods throw NotImplementedException.
PolygonModifier and most TriMesh raw-buffer conversion helpers throw NotImplementedException in this FOSS build.
NURBS curve evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion throw NotImplementedException despite NURBS data construction support.
3MF build-instruction metadata and RVM attribute loading are not implemented despite core geometry support.
License and Metered APIs exist for API compatibility but are not applicable to this open-source edition.

problems_solved.text: Enables 3D scene graph construction from primitives and CAD-style profiles using pure managed code.
Supports round-trip conversion between widely used 3D interchange formats including FBX, glTF, OBJ, STL, COLLADA, and U3D.
Provides shading material assignment and conversion, including Lambert-to-PBR material transformation.
Allows per-format load/save configuration through dedicated options types for OBJ, FBX, glTF, STL, and COLLADA.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source, MIT-licensed .NET library for building and converting 3D scenes without any external 3D engine.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported IFC profiles beyond those named in examples is not fully enumerated in facts.
Whether all format-specific options types (e.g., RvmLoadOptions, A3dwSaveOptions) have working encoders/decoders behind them is not fully confirmed by examples.
The behavior of Scene.FromStream and Save(Stream) for all supported formats beyond COLLADA is not explicitly demonstrated in examples.
